answer: Sybil resistance binds each identity to a Wesolowski VDF whose prescribed chain of modular squarings is sequential: each square depends on the previous result. GPUs can verify many proofs or run separate chains, but cannot divide one chain to reduce its delay. Thus every clone incurs its own full physical time and work, imposing a strict bottleneck even when an attacker deploys parallel hardware across an orchard, dune, or atlas.
